WwUnitModeEnumeration.description: This enumeration represents the generalized mode of a unit.

OTHER.description: This state is used if none of the other states below applies.

AUTOMATIC.description: The unit is in automatic mode.

SEMIAUTOMATIC.description: The unit is in semi-automatic mode.

MANUAL.description: The unit is in manual mode.

SETUP.description: The unit is in setup mode.

SLEEP.description: The unit is in sleep mode. Component is still switched on, energy consumption reduced by e.g. reducing heating, switching drives off. Production is not possible.
